verdict.rationale: cubic documents automatic PR summaries ('Generates PR descriptions based on code changes'), configurable through cubic.yaml and enriched with Notion context. A changelog entry describes grouped change descriptions that stay beside the diff as reviewers scroll, which works like a change walkthrough. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that summaries are generated automatically on every PR (only reviews are stated as automatic), in-depth docs on the walkthrough/grouped-change feature beyond a changelog line (the main PR-description page sits in an archive section), and independent hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
